failure_case.description: Mutant m08 escaped under same-file heuristic but was caught by Guard.
failure_case.analysis: Under the same-file heuristic, mutant m08 only executed tests matching its source file stem, which did not trigger the failure. In contrast, Guard analyzed the call graph and per-test coverage evidence in FalkorDB, correctly identifying covering tests across modules or falling back safely when trust was insufficient (guard_is_fallback=False, guard_selected_tests_count=26), preventing an escape.
